title: Pylons Parity Spec Schema
description: The closed schema for the parity: section in manifests/pylons.yaml and its per-project overrides. Unknown keys are hard errors.

use.description: builtin:<language> selects an in-process profile; external:<name> selects the enabled extension <name>, run as the pylon-ext-<name> binary.

options.description: Open per-profile options bag; keys are validated per profile.

extensions.description: Extra file extensions this profile claims. Two profiles claiming one extension is a config error.
